published_prior_art.cite: LeimenstollSchienle2026 gives fixed-order CTC endpoints and fixed-regime inference; GneccoEtAl2021 gives the equal-index endpoint, not the local collision curve.
Exact Pareto membership in a second-order class is a routine verification, though no cited CTC paper states this triangular-array formulation.
BeirlantBouquiauxWerker2006 supplies the root-k tail-index LAN coordinate, not its compatibility with the logarithmic CTC-mixture coordinate.
BeirlantBouquiauxWerker2006, Drees1998, and BuecherDette2013 treat separate univariate/tail-process components; no located result gives the marked causal-mixture collision experiment.
CarpentierKim2014CI and SasakiWang2024 give scalar-tail honest intervals, not a selected bivariate CTC direction confidence set at the ordering boundary.
Novak2014 and BeirlantBouquiauxWerker2006 give marginal heavy-tail lower-bound machinery, not opposite-orientation marked-CTC contiguity.

novelty_flags.label: Theorem 1 / related_work / comparator_promise_table
novelty_flags.one_line: LeimenstollSchienle2026 v1 labels the heterogeneous-tail endpoint result Proposition 3.1 and its tail-regime CLT Theorem 4.4; describing “Proposition 1, equation (A.23), and Theorems 1--3” as the fixed-regime comparison is not an accurate location or theorem characterization.

soundness_flags.label: ass:positive-compact-coefficient
soundness_flags.one_line: The cited anchor assumes nonnegative/nonzero structural coefficients, not a coefficient uniformly bounded away from zero and infinity; either justify this compact-uniform strengthening as novel/needed or cite a source that states it.

soundness_flags.label: ass:tail-constant-balance
soundness_flags.one_line: GneccoEtAl2021 assumes comparable tails with a common fixed index and slowly varying factor (then rescales constants); it does not establish the stated triangular-array ratio c_1,n/c_2,n→c_0 across colliding unequal indices.

soundness_flags.label: def:collision-model-class and Open-ended Question 2
soundness_flags.one_line: The class is a set of observed-law sequences P_n but coverage is for the latent label o_n; parameterize the class by structural tuples (P_n,o_n,epsilon_1,n,epsilon_2,n,...) or first define a unique direction functional of P_n.

soundness_flags.label: ass:uniform-second-order-variation / R_n / Open-ended Question 1
soundness_flags.one_line: The tail constants c_j,n used in R_n are not linked by a displayed tail-equivalence condition to the innovations or quantile functions, and “compact feasible” parameter sets for kappa=0 and kappa=infinity are not defined.

soundness_flags.label: Open-ended Question 3
soundness_flags.one_line: Without explicitly minimizing over confidence sets satisfying a stated uniform 1-eta coverage constraint on a defined local parameter set, a singleton constant report has non-singleton probability zero and the proposed minimax ambiguity objective is vacuous.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Open-ended Question 3
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The converse concerns only procedures measurable with respect to the specified CTC tail-rank sigma-field, not unrestricted direction learning from the full observational distribution.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The ambiguity lower envelope is conditional on the tail-rank experiment and does not claim a lower bound for full-body LiNGAM-style causal discovery.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Section 3.1, Proposition 3.1; Section 4, Theorems 4.1, 4.3, and 4.4; Appendix A.6
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper gives the fixed heterogeneous-tail CTC endpoint cases in Proposition 3.1 and a gap-dependent intermediate-sequence CLT in Theorem 4.4; its displayed theorem numbering is not the claimed Proposition 1/Theorems 1--3 formulation.

The published setup assumes a common tail index alpha and common slowly varying factor ell with positive constants c_j, then rescales c_j to one; it does not state a colliding triangular-array tail-constant ratio condition.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Redefine the model as structural triangular-array tuples, state P(epsilon_j,n>x)~c_j,n x^{-alpha_j,n} (or the corresponding quantile normalization), and define the feasible extended-kappa parameter spaces before posing the joint experiment.

Rewrite Open-ended Question 3 as an infimum over uniformly 1-eta honest tail-rank confidence sets and a supremum over an explicitly named compact local parameter set; then state the loss and the matching upper-envelope criterion precisely.
Correct all Leimenstoll--Schienle theorem/equation anchors and distinguish its fixed-fraction empirical-copula CLT from its intermediate-sequence heterogeneous-tail result.

Give the adaptive set an explicit finite grid, confidence level eta, and oracle ambiguity bound indexed by named separation quantities derived from the joint experiment; this turns the handle into a reproducible estimator-and-coverage target.

recommended_next_step: Revise the structural parameterization, tail-constant normalization, local minimax objective, and anchor citations; the repaired joint marked-experiment plus honest-set and matching-frontier program remains flagship-eligible.
